**Install:** download `PetTracker-Setup-*.exe` below and run it. You need [Npcap](https://npcap.com/#download) installed (it comes with Wireshark). Start Pet Tracker before you log into your character.

**Updating:** run the new installer over the old one, no uninstall needed. Your pets and settings are kept. From 0.4.1 on, the overlay also shows an **Update** button when a new version is out; one click installs it and restarts the app.

`PetTracker-*-portable.zip` is the same app without the installer: unzip it anywhere and run `PetTracker.exe` (keep the `maps` folder next to it).

See the [README](https://github.com/caiooncoding/aion-pet-tracker#readme) for how it works.
